official_course_code.name: official_course_code
official_course_code.value: "cenit"."academic_courses"."official_code" IS NULL OR (length("cenit"."academic_courses"."official_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 50 AND "cenit"."academic_courses"."official_code" = btrim("cenit"."academic_courses"."official_code"))

account_email.name: account_email
account_email.value: length("cenit"."accounts"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND "cenit"."accounts"."email" = lower(btrim("cenit"."accounts"."email")) AND "cenit"."accounts"."email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'

purchase_line_amounts.name: purchase_line_amounts
purchase_line_amounts.value: ("cenit"."purchase_request_lines"."price" IS NULL OR "cenit"."purchase_request_lines"."price" >= 0) AND ("cenit"."purchase_request_lines"."amount" IS NULL OR "cenit"."purchase_request_lines"."amount" >= 0)

purchase_line_finite_amounts.name: purchase_line_finite_amounts

purchase_source.name: purchase_source
purchase_source.value: (("cenit"."purchase_requests"."source" = 'manual' AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."example_id" IS NULL) OR ("cenit"."purchase_requests"."source" = 'contract_example' AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."example_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."example_id" IN ('recovered', 'partial', 'ambiguous'))) AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."extraction_id" IS NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."processor_version" IS NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."processed_at" IS NULL OR ("cenit"."purchase_requests"."source" = 'image_capture' AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."example_id" IS NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."extraction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."processor_version" IS NOT NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."processor_version" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,100}$' AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("cenit"."purchase_requests"."processed_at"))

purchase_review.name: purchase_review
purchase_review.value: ("cenit"."purchase_requests"."review_status" = 'pending' AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("cenit"."purchase_requests"."review_status" = 'reviewed' AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cenit"."purchase_requests"."reviewed_at" >= "cenit"."purchase_requests"."created_at")
